images.caption: Figure 2:A harness revision and a weight update act on different terms. Summit heights are the ceilings, the robot’s altitude is its return, and the gap between them is the mismatch. Moving the trained model to the new harness with frozen weights (① to ②) raises the ceiling but lowers the return. Updating the weights under the new harness (② to ③) lowers only the mismatch. The adapted model beats the source checkpoint under the original harness once its mismatchM′M^{\prime}falls belowTT, the new ceiling minus the source checkpoint’s return under the original harness.
